scale_note: Character scale is PERSON-001 r002 (1.70 m, R). Prop sizes (bobbin 0.24 m, beater 0.72 m) and all postures/timings are R game-fit choices. Placement uses LOOM-001 r001 weaver_origin (0.70 m in front of the loom) and cloth_face.

placement.character: root := loom.global_transform * weaver_origin (LOOM-001 r001 node; 0.70 m in front, rotated 180 deg so the character faces the loom). No other offset.
placement.cloth_face_plane_in_character_space: 0.778 m in front of the character root (glTF z = +0.778), normal towards the character
placement.props: prop_root.global = hold_node.global * inverse(prop.grip.local); bobbin hold switches L/R at weave_pass u = 0.50 and 0.90 (both holds coincide there); beater only during weave_beat
placement.godot_import_settings: person_weaving.glb.import _subresources: animations weave_pass and weave_beat settings/loop_mode=1 (LINEAR); nodes PATH:AnimationPlayer optimizer/enabled=false (recommended, configuration B). checks/godot_person_weaving.glb.import.txt
placement.game_sequencing: weave_enter -> (weave_pass | weave_beat | weave_shed_change)* in any order (all start/end on READY) -> weave_exit; time follows the simulation clock

models.role: motion study: unchanged PERSON-001 r002 body/rig/skin/palette + five new in-place weaving clips + three hand hold nodes
models.budget_basis: character: unchanged PERSON-001 r002 mesh (2,052); same 2,500 ceiling WORK-001 used
models.root_transform: identity (no TRS stored on the scene root ['PERSON_rig'])

bobbin_hold_L.note: NEW, child of joint hand.L: world pose of weft_bobbin `grip` while the LEFT hand holds it (weave_pass u in [0, 0.50) and [0.90, 1.0)); weft_bobbin root = bobbin_hold_L * inverse(grip)

beater_hold.note: NEW, child of joint hand.R: world pose of sword_beater `grip` during weave_beat (whole loop); sword_beater root = beater_hold * inverse(grip)

bobbin_hold_R.note: NEW, child of joint hand.R: world pose of weft_bobbin `grip` while the RIGHT hand holds it (weave_pass u in [0.50, 0.90)); at the two hand-overs (u=0.50 and 0.90) both holds coincide within 1e-6 m

carry_anchor.note: unchanged PERSON-001 r002 node (child of hand.R); not used by the weaving clips

animations.name: weave_enter
animations.first_pose: PERSON-001 r002 idle t=0 (seam vs fixture clip_idle(0): {'max_bone_rotation_diff_deg': 2e-06, 'max_bone_head_diff_m': 0.0})
animations.last_pose: READY: trunk leant ~27 deg towards the loom, hands 8.8 cm in front of the cloth at the fell zone (left hand in the bobbin grip, right hand in the beater grip)
animations.behaviour: R: feet stay planted on the idle footprints; trunk leans forward and both arms come up from the idle hang onto the READY grips

animations.name: weave_pass
animations.loop: seamless linear loop (last key = first key)
animations.godot_loop_mode: LOOP_LINEAR (import option; glTF has no loop flag)
animations.behaviour: R: left hand takes the bobbin to the left selvedge, inserts it in the shed 11 cm below the fell (u 0.16-0.25), pushes it to the middle (0.25-0.48); hand-over inside the shed (0.48-0.52); right hand draws it to the right selvedge (0.52-0.74) and out (0.74-0.80), carries it back in front of the cloth (0.80-0.88), hand-over 2 to the left hand (0.88-0.92), both back to READY
animations.prop: weft_bobbin: bobbin_hold_L for u in [0, 0.50) and [0.90, 1.0); bobbin_hold_R for u in [0.50, 0.90)

animations.name: weave_beat
animations.loop: seamless linear loop (last key = first key)
animations.behaviour: R: sword beater (right hand on the grip, left fist on the blade 0.36 m along) inserted into the shed (u 0-0.14), two upward beats to 6 mm below the fell (tops at u 0.27 and 0.55), withdrawn to READY (0.72-0.86)
animations.prop: sword_beater: beater_hold for the whole loop

held_prop_vs_warp.note: whole-prop values include the 12-16 mm radius grip/knob, which sits in the right fist inside the warp width

animations.name: weave_shed_change
animations.loop: none (one-shot, start and end on READY)
animations.behaviour: R: both hands move down onto the heddle rod (x = +-0.30 m), close (u 0.28-0.34), tug the rod 10 mm forward and 12 mm up (0.38-0.62), set it back and release (0.62-0.78), return to READY. LOOM-001 r001's heddle rod is part of the static frame mesh, so the rod itself does not move (see deviations)

hands_vs_heddle_rod.note: minimum signed distance of each hand's vertices to the rod surface per sample (negative = fingers wrapped into the rod); max_of_min shows the hand never leaves the rod

models.export_bounds_note: rest/bind pose from the POSITION accessor (identical to PERSON-001 r002); animated poses differ
models.root_motion: none: PERSON_rig root identity and never animated; only the pelvis joint translates (local), all other joints rotate

models.root_transform: identity (no TRS stored on the scene root ['WEFT_BOBBIN'])

grip.note: prop grip point (identity rotation; prop +X = long axis). Hold-node attachment: prop_root = hold * inverse(grip)

models.role: hand prop: wooden sword beater 0.72 m (blade 0.58 m x 0.052 m, thin beating edge, round grip with knob)
models.root_transform: identity (no TRS stored on the scene root ['SWORD_BEATER'])

grip.note: prop grip point (identity rotation; prop +X = long axis). Hold-node attachment: prop_root = hold * inverse(grip)

weaver_with_bobbin_godot_gpu.note: person_weaving + weft_bobbin only, ground hidden (Godot RENDER_INFO, visible pass)

contact_requirement.brief: Hands within 30 mm of the cloth_face plane during pass/beat
contact_requirement.measure: hand = centroid of the skinned vertices bound mainly to hand.X/fingers.X (114 per hand); also the held prop grip point. Windows: pass = bobbin inside the shed (left hand u 0.25-0.50, right hand 0.50-0.74, both at the hand-over 0.48-0.52); beat = beater inside the shed u 0.14-0.72

reference_ids: S-CH19 (Chvojka, Menšík, Šálková & Kuna 2019, Archeologické rozhledy 71: 267–308) as summarised in content/research/economy/crafts-exchange.md §2.3 (branch docs/economy-research): weight function unresolved, classic warp-weighted suspension 'rather unlikely', base-up tying hypothesised (pp. 291–293); mass deposits are waste, not looms in situ (pp. 270, 301). Not re-read for this job.

content/research/economy/crafts-exchange.md §3 table row 'Textiles' (fibre prep -> spin -> weave R; loom with weights, function debated E; weaving indoors/winter R) and §F7 'Spinning and weaving' (upright frame with a row of clay weights; R parameters)
content/research/economy/subsistence.md F10 (wool -> textile chain; sheep presence unverified locally)
content/research/next-batch/material-culture.md §5 'LOOM-001 — upright warp-weighted loom' (R throughout; no in-situ loom at Březnice) and §4 table row LOOM-001

MC02 (Wolfgang Sauber, 'Museum Quintana - Webstuhl 1.jpg', Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0; content/research/next-batch/references/MC02-loom-reconstruction-quintana.jpg): modern museum reconstruction, viewed for general readability only (it shows a weft ball and a long loose stick); no pixels copied, no measurement taken
LOOM-001 r001 return (branch art/loom-001-r001, commit 54f0601): weaver_origin, cloth_face, heddle/shed rod and warp-layer geometry (source/gen_report.json key_positions_gltf, warp_back, warp_front)
parts_and_uncertainties: Weaving technique (two-hand bobbin pass, sword-beater beat-up towards the fell, heddle-rod tug) is R: no Březnice evidence for loom type, weaving posture or tools; S-CH19 leaves loom function unresolved
Weft bobbin (stick with wound weft) and sword beater are generic R tool forms; no regional find is modelled; wood/wool colours are design choices

READY posture leans ~27 deg forward because LOOM-001 weaver_origin is 0.70 m in front of the loom (cloth plane 0.778 m from the root); a closer weaver_origin (~0.45-0.5 m) would allow an upright stance
The heddle rod in LOOM-001 r001 is static frame geometry: weave_shed_change shows the grasp/tug but the rod and warp sheds cannot change state
Hands enter the shed through the alpha-mask warp cards (fingers pass between card threads); the cards are thin planes, so no thread deformation is shown

deviations: Two extra clips beyond the brief's three: weave_enter / weave_exit (idle t=0 <-> READY), so every clip starts/ends on the r002 idle pose or on the shared READY pose (WORK-001 precedent: grind_enter/grind/grind_exit).
weave_shed_change is a 2.0 s one-shot that starts and ends on READY (the brief gives only the duration); the rod tug is 10 mm forward / 12 mm up because the LOOM-001 rod is static.

The bobbin is held by two hold nodes (bobbin_hold_L, bobbin_hold_R) with documented switch times, because a left->right pass needs a hand-over; the beater uses beater_hold. The brief named only `grip` on the beater; the bobbin also has `grip`.
The five PERSON r002 clips are not carried in person_weaving.glb (like WORK-001 and the batch-8 siblings); the game keeps using PERSON r002 for idle/walk.
tools/inspect_asset.py was not run or edited (it does not know batch-8 IDs); independent measurements are in checks/.
